question: Name the programme launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to empower all healthcare workers engaged in oxygen management and administration with the essential knowledge and skills.
solution:
The correct answer is **__National Oxygen Stewardship Programme__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Bharati Pravin Pawar** inaugurates **National Oxygen Stewardship Programme, **Initiative envisages the Identification and Training of **“Oxygen Steward”** in each district across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Government of India has sanctioned** more than 1500 Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) oxygen generation plants** of which** 1463** have been **commissioned **which include,** 1225 PSA plants **which have been installed and commissioned under **PMCARES** Fund in **every district** of the country.
 
• The **National Oxygen Stewardship Program** of the **Union Health Ministry** was launched at **AIIMS New Delhi** on **December 22, 2022**, by **Dr. Bharati Pravin Pawar**, **Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare**.
 
• The program recognizes the importance of **medical oxygen** as a **life-saving public health commodity **and the need to train** healthcare professionals** in its handling.
 
• The program is to equip all healthcare professionals involved in the** management and administration of oxygen** with the **necessary knowledge and abilities** to guarantee the** prudent use of medical oxygen** and **prevent any waste**, particularly in environments with limited resources.
 
• The goal is to find and educate a minimum of one **"Oxygen Steward"** in **every district** throughout the nation.
 
• These qualified experts would oversee oxygen therapy and management training in their respective districts and assist with oxygen delivery audits and surge scenario readiness.
